cleanup_panel.title: Cleanup
cleanup_panel.hero_sub: Surgical resets. Each one names exactly what it clears and what it keeps. Analytics survives everything except the bulk erase.
cleanup_panel.row_transcripts_desc: Empties every chat panel. Run history and analytics are kept.
cleanup_panel.row_drafts_desc: Discards every in-progress prompt sitting in a composer.
cleanup_panel.row_orphaned_runs_desc: Deletes runs left interrupted by an app crash or forced kill.
cleanup_panel.row_agent_memory_desc: Removes per-agent memory. The global memory file is preserved.
cleanup_panel.row_user_analysis_desc: Deletes the About You dossier. Regenerates on the next analyst run.
cleanup_panel.row_skill_cache_desc: Wipes installed skills. They reinstall on next use.
cleanup_panel.row_ui_settings_desc: Clears theme, layout, and tab persistence. Migration sentinel is kept.
cleanup_panel.erase_desc: Every row above plus runs, messages and tool calls. Analytics is destroyed. Files in your projects are untouched.

performance_tab.title: Rendering budget

performance_tab.mode_full_note: Everything on. Best-looking interface, heaviest per frame.
performance_tab.mode_lite_note: Flat surfaces, no PixiJS. Fast on older or throttled machines.
performance_tab.mode_off_note: Minimal render load. Utilitarian, no motion beyond status.
performance_tab.matrix_sub: override any single row without leaving your mode
performance_tab.footer_note: status LEDs keep animating in every mode — they are essential feedback

providers.title: AI provider
providers.hero_sub: Where agents run. Agent Office uses exactly the provider you pick, and never switches to another on its own.
providers.never_swaps: If the provider you pick can't run, agents stop and tell you why. Nothing falls back to another provider.
providers.option_subscription_tag: Default. Uses your claude login, no key needed.
providers.option_anthropic_api_tag: Pay per token with your own key.
providers.option_openai_tag: Pay per token with an OpenAI key.
providers.option_local_tag: Ollama, LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server.
providers.privacy_subscription: Prompts and file contents go to Anthropic through your Claude login.
providers.privacy_anthropic_api: Prompts and file contents go to Anthropic with your API key.
providers.privacy_openai: Prompts and file contents go to OpenAI, or to the address you set.
providers.privacy_local: Prompts and file contents go only to the server address you enter. Nothing leaves your network unless that server sends it on.
providers.key_write_only: Stored encrypted on this device. It is never shown again, only its last four characters.
providers.key_clears_warning: Changing the address removes the saved key. Enter a new key to keep using this provider.
providers.url_hint_openai: Leave empty to use OpenAI's own address.
providers.url_hint_local: An OpenAI-compatible address, usually ending in /v1.
providers.url_invalid: That isn't a valid http or https address.
providers.url_credentials: Remove the username and password from the address. Put a key in the key field instead.
providers.models_hint: Agents ask for Fast, Balanced or Deep. Choose the model each one runs on.
providers.model_use_one: Use one model for every tier
providers.model_use_per_tier: Use a different model per tier
providers.checked_ok_before: The last check passed. Test again to be sure.
providers.switch_confirm: Running agents finish on {from}. New turns use {to}.
providers.prices_hint: Prices come from a public catalog, not from this app. They set spending caps for OpenAI and fill the price labels in the agent editor.
providers.prices_unavailable: Prices unavailable (offline or not fetched yet).
providers.accounts_note: Agents run on {provider} now. These Claude accounts hold sessions and shared files only; the plan and sign-in apply to the subscription.
providers.caps_need_price: Spending caps need a known price. With {provider} they can't be enforced until its model prices are known, so a run that has a cap is refused rather than allowed to overspend.
providers.reserved_name_note: {name} is reserved. Agents never receive it from a project secret, because it selects which AI provider runs. Set the provider in Settings instead.
providers.context_cost_note: Dollar figures here use Anthropic's prices and don't apply to {provider}. Token counts still do.
providers.key_shape_anthropic_key_for_openai: This looks like an Anthropic key. OpenAI keys usually start with sk-.
providers.key_shape_not_an_anthropic_key: Anthropic keys usually start with sk-ant-. Check that this key is from Anthropic.
